name: RLB1014-332KL
description: Bourns RLB1014-332KL, a 3.3 mH +/-10 % radial lead inductor of the RLB1014 series (ferrite drum core, 8.7 mm by 12 mm, 5 mm lead spacing): DC resistance 10.5 ohm maximum, rated current 0.22 A, 0.23 A saturation current (10 % inductance drop), self-resonance above 0.45 MHz, Q 50. The model: the inductance with its maximum DC resistance and a parallel capacitance setting resonance at the minimum SRF.
